title: Responsible Diffusion: A Comprehensive Survey on Safety, Ethics, and Trust in Diffusion Models

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying literature that evaluates model underperformance and disparities on underrepresented gender groups (e.g., in medical image generation) and reviewing mitigation strategies like counterfactual modules and debiasing latent representations to reduce sensitivity to protected attributes.
Reviewing fairness concerns and performance disparities associated with long-tailed age distributions in training datasets, specifically highlighted in medical image generation applications.
Identifying biases in generative outputs caused by the underrepresentation of certain cultures or styles in creative media and content generation datasets.
